x_query.oql:
works where date >= (1900-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-16)
  and title/abstract has (
    stemmed "NASA-Task Load Index (NASA-TLX); 20 Years Later"
    or stemmed "Workload and Performance: Associations, Insensitivities, and Dissociations"
    or stemmed "queueing formula"
    or stemmed "queuing formula"
    or (
      (agile or developer or software)
      and (
        (
          stemmed "developer productivity"
          and (interruption or measure or perception or performance)
        )
        or (
          stemmed "modern code review"
          and (
            challenge
            or cognitive
            or effort
            or outcome
            or understanding
            or workload
          )
        )
        or (
          stemmed "perceptions of productivity"
          and stemmed "software developers"
        )
        or (
          (
            stemmed "relative estimate"
            or stemmed "story point"
            or stemmed "story points"
          )
          and (accuracy or change or effort or reliability or validity)
        )
      )
    )
  )
